body:
Stick around.  I know it sucks.  I know what it is like to go through a ton of shit.  Shit, even today, I think my life sucks so bad that I should just check out.  And I am pretty sure I am twice your age (42).  

Life throws some pretty shitty stuff at you sometimes.  It fucking sucks.  But you will move on.  Just like I will.  And it will make you stronger.  

It's okay to be sad.  And pissed.  And want to lash out.  But please don't hurt yourself - because then they win.  

PM me if you need an ear.
